settings.routePlanner.hsl.description: HSL is the Helsinki Region Transport authority. Their Digitransit API provides high-quality bike routing across Finland — including Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, Oulu, and other regions covered by published GTFS feeds. The key is free — sign in at the portal, register an app, and copy the subscription key into the field above. Outside Finland, leave HSL off and the planner uses OSM routing globally.
settings.routePlanner.riding.footnote: Cycling speed overrides HSL ETAs (Digitransit defaults to a slow bike speed). Speed unit is how the live-speed badge is shown on the map.
